text:
Maya: spinning up paperwing14b-int4 on canary, hitting 1.2GB GPU mem spike after warmup despite low qps. OOMs after ~40s on a subset of shards. Anyone seen frag during prefix-KV prefetch?
Ravi: yeah saw this pattern on cedar last month. slab+slot fragmentation. what's the canary config? share snippets
Maya: current canary config: `max_new_tokens: 512`, `batch_size: 2`, `prefetch_slots: 4`, `quant: int4` — starting warmup at session init
Kevin: try `prefetch_slots: 1` + lower `max_new_tokens` to `256` for canary. also set `kv_evict_threshold: 0.6` and enable `batch_throttle_ms: 20` as a soft guard
Maya: applying to canary now, pushing config patch and small rollout. will monitor allocs and OOM counts
deploy-bot: deploy started: canary/paperwing14b-int4 config-change -> nodes: 3. logs available at https://ci.redwood/infralog/6412345678
Anya: if that reduces spikes we should add a warmup perf test and a checklist item for onboarding (prefetch defaults + slab tuning)
Maya: quick numbers: first run peak mem -30%, no OOMs across 120 warmup requests. throughput ~same. scheduling full canary sweep and bench. :tada:
Kevin: nice — after full roll we should add an eval to track quality impact from lowering `max_new_tokens` and consider dynamic per-route override
Maya: created ticket RW-ML-9831 to update onboarding docs and perf tests. cc @Anya @Kevin
